class.name: PhysX
class.brief_description: Script queries about the PhysX physics backend.
class.description: Static queries about the PhysX backend as a whole, for a game that adapts to the machine it runs on, e.g. choosing [PhysXParticleFluid3D]'s solver or how much debris to spawn: [codeblock] if PhysX.is_gpu_available(): print("GPU physics on ", PhysX.get_gpu_device_name()) [/codeblock]

method.name: body_get_contact_force_limit
method.description: Returns the contact force limit of [param body] set with [method body_set_contact_force_limit], [code]0.0[/code] for none.

method.name: body_set_contact_force_limit
method.description: Limits the force (in newtons) any contact of [param body] gives the other body of the pair: in a physics step the solver applies at most [param newtons] × step of impulse per pair of touching shapes, shared by its contact points (the lower limit when both bodies have one). [code]0.0[/code] removes the limit (the default). Mainly for a kinematic body pushed into others, e.g. an item held in a hand: without a limit it pushes with infinite mass, with one at most with [param newtons], while a body resting on it stays as long as its weight is under the limit. The contact still resolves at that force only, so a body pushed harder than the limit can sink into the limited one. [param body] is a body RID ([method CollisionObject3D.get_rid]); call it from the main thread, between physics steps.

method.name: get_gpu_device_name
method.description: Returns the name of the CUDA device GPU dynamics runs on (for example [code]"NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070"[/code]), or an empty string when [method is_gpu_available] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_gpu_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when PhysX is the active physics engine and is running GPU dynamics on a CUDA device. It is [code]false[/code] in a build without GPU support, on a machine without a usable NVIDIA GPU or without [code]PhysXGpu[/code] shipped next to the executable, with [code]physics/physx_3d/simulation/enhanced_determinism[/code] on, or when another physics engine is selected. Without it, GPU-only features fall back or stay inert: [PhysXParticleFluid3D] with the PBD solver, GPU cloth and so on. Valid once the physics server has started (from any node's [code]_ready[/code] on).
